checks.title: Exported And Unprotected Activities That Expose Sensitive Functionality
checks.reason: The exported StartupActivity reads an Intent from its own extras and starts it if it targets the app's package, so any app can open non-exported activities with attacker-chosen extras (after the PIN gate, or directly when no PIN is set). ModernMain and GiftBoxRootActivity are behind the global PIN gate and accept only a boolean argument. Ward's analyzer said: Exported activities without a permission. Ward lists them; check whether each one exposes sensitive functionality or trusts its intent's data.

evidence.detail: Caller-supplied Intent is taken from the exported activity's extras.
The redirected intent is launched with the app's identity, reaching non-exported activities.

activity .activity.modern.ModernMain; exported: yes (android:exported is set)
